answer: Admission is gated by graded work: new identities must clear a proof-of-work door and accrue jury-matched seals across distinct challenges before answer-pay fully vests. Fresh falcons cannot swoop in and feed at the oasis on day one — clones pay the same entry toll as everyone else, per head. Disposable accounts echo each other's text, and continuity checks catch the chorus. The coordination cost of keeping many identities active and correctly graded rises faster than the reward. Attacker cost: the full admission run per puppet, no shortcuts. Honest long-runners clear the bar naturally.
